title: RL Post-training (async)
description: Concurrent rollout and Megatron training diagnostics. Select one run and job, then the execution processes to inspect. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.

params.value: SELECT run_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND name IN ('lifecycle','policy_step','rollout_call') AND json_get(resource_attributes_json,'training_loop')='async') GROUP BY run_id HAVING run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT job_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})) GROUP BY job_id HAVING job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT execution_uid AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring})) GROUP BY execution_uid HAVING execution_uid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

panels.title: Optimizer and synced policy steps
panels.description: Per-bucket maximum of policy_step (the trainer's current optimizer step) and the model version carried on weight_sync_completed, one series per execution. policy_step is set on every step; weight_sync_completed fires after each weight sync to the vLLM engines. The weight-sync series needs trainer.training_metrics; policy_step is always on.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('policy_step','weight_sync_completed') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, name || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, MAX(CASE WHEN name='policy_step' THEN value ELSE CAST(json_get(body_json,'model_version_step') AS DOUBLE) END) AS value FROM r GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generated and consumed response tokens / s
panels.description: Per-second rate of work_completed token counts for generated_token, consumed_response_token and consumed_loss_token, summed per bucket. Generation workers record generated tokens when a group finishes; the trainer records consumed tokens after each optimizer step. The generated-token series is always on; the two consumed-token series need trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'work_completed' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json,'work_kind') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, SUM(value) * 1000.0 / ${__interval_ms} AS value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'work_kind') IN ('generated_token','consumed_response_token','consumed_loss_token') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Process lifecycle
panels.description: Latest lifecycle or terminal event per process: its status, exit reason and last-record time. Every trainer, generation-worker and controller process emits lifecycle on start and terminal on exit. Always on when telemetry is configured; a completed process does not by itself mean training succeeded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('lifecycle','terminal') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT execution_uid, json_get(resource_attributes_json,'role') AS role, COALESCE(json_get(resource_attributes_json,'actor_uid'),json_get(resource_attributes_json,'ray_task_id'),json_get(resource_attributes_json,'host')) AS process, name AS event, COALESCE(json_get(body_json,'status'),json_get(body_json,'state')) AS status, json_get(body_json,'reason') AS reason, timestamp_ms AS last_record_ms FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC,seq DESC) AS newest FROM r) WHERE newest=1 ORDER BY last_record_ms DESC

panels.title: Driver step, preparation and policy walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for the driver's step, wait_for_generation_buffer, run_training, fwd_logprobs_values_reward and train_critic_and_policy phases, per bucket. Each is a Timer span the trainer publishes after every step. Always on when telemetry is configured; step, run_training and train_critic_and_policy are nested, so never add them.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('step','wait_for_generation_buffer','run_training','fwd_logprobs_values_reward','train_critic_and_policy') AND COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'outcome'),'success')='success' AND json_get(attributes_json,'role')='trainer' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generation worker await duration
panels.description: Mean and max rollout_wait_seconds by wait name (prompt, slot, enqueue, model_client_await, env_await), the mean normalized by rollout_waits. Generation workers record these inside TrajectoryRunner.run(), including the wait on AsyncStalenessManager.acquire_submission_slot(). Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('rollout_wait_seconds','rollout_waits') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), w AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'wait') AS wait,execution_uid,name,json_get(attributes_json,'stat') AS stat,value FROM r), g AS (SELECT t,wait,CASE WHEN wait IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE execution_uid END AS execution_uid,SUM(CASE WHEN name='rollout_wait_seconds' AND stat='sum' THEN value END) AS wait_seconds,SUM(CASE WHEN name='rollout_waits' THEN value END) AS waits,MAX(CASE WHEN name='rollout_wait_seconds' AND stat='max' THEN value END) AS longest_wait,COUNT(CASE WHEN name='rollout_wait_seconds' AND stat='max' THEN 1 END) AS longest_samples FROM w GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT t,wait || ' ' || summary || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN summary='mean' THEN wait_seconds / NULLIF(waits,0) ELSE longest_wait END AS value FROM g CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('mean'),('max')) AS summaries(summary) WHERE summary='mean' OR longest_samples>0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completed buffer depth and capacity
panels.description: Latest rollout_queue_depth and rollout_capacity gauges per bucket: the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer's occupancy against trainer.fully_async.max_buffered_groups. The trainer updates both whenever a group enters or leaves the buffer. Always on when telemetry is configured; sampled zeros can miss short occupancy bursts.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('rollout_queue_depth','rollout_capacity') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT t,name || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)),execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC,seq DESC) AS newest FROM r) WHERE newest=1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumed buffer dwell
panels.description: p50/p95/max of rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds for groups with disposition=consumed: time from group completion to trainer admission. Recorded when a consumed group leaves the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), d AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,execution_uid,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS p50,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS p95,MAX(value) AS longest FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'disposition')='consumed' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT t,stat || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN stat='p50' THEN p50 WHEN stat='p95' THEN p95 ELSE longest END AS value FROM d CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('p50'),('p95'),('max')) AS stats(stat) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumed policy staleness
panels.description: p50/p95/max of rollout_staleness_steps: how many optimizer steps behind the model was when each admitted group was consumed. The trainer records one observation per group against max_staleness_steps. Always on when telemetry is configured; rejected groups are excluded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'rollout_staleness_steps' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), d AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,execution_uid,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS p50,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS p95,MAX(value) AS longest FROM r GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT t,stat || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN stat='p50' THEN p50 WHEN stat='p95' THEN p95 ELSE longest END AS value FROM d CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('p50'),('p95'),('max')) AS stats(stat) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Successful rollout-call latency
panels.description: p50/p95/max of phase_duration_seconds for phase=rollout_call: the wall time of one successful TrajectoryRunner.run() call. Recorded by observe_rollout_call around each generation-worker rollout. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), d AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,execution_uid,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS p50,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS p95,MAX(value) AS longest FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT t,stat || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN stat='p50' THEN p50 WHEN stat='p95' THEN p95 ELSE longest END AS value FROM d CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('p50'),('p95'),('max')) AS stats(stat) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weight synchronization and policy offload walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for sync_weights, init_weight_sync_state, offload_policy_model_to_cpu and update_ref_with_policy, split by outcome and execution. sync_weights times broadcast_to_inference_engines; the rest time the one-time sync-state setup and the optimizer offload around it. Always on when telemetry is configured; these are elapsed waits, not GPU kernel time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'outcome'),'success') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,AVG(value) AS value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('sync_weights','init_weight_sync_state','offload_policy_model_to_cpu','update_ref_with_policy') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Driver event-loop lag
panels.description: Max event_loop_lag_seconds per bucket: how late the driver's asyncio loop ran past its scheduled tick. Sampled once a second by monitor_event_loop_lag on the trainer's event loop. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'event_loop_lag_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'max lag' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Signed timing residuals
panels.description: Min signed phase_duration_seconds for rollout_call_residual and ppo_train_residual, by rank and execution: wall time inside a span not attributed to any named child phase. Negative values expose overlapping child accounting and are not clamped. Empty without trainer.async_spans (rollout residual) or trainer.policy_train_spans (Megatron residual).

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' rank ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'rank'),'driver') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MIN(value) AS value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('rollout_call_residual','ppo_train_residual') AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Concurrent work and terminal group dispositions
Rollouts completing during policy training
panels.description: Successful rollout_call events whose finish falls inside an async_phase_window phase=training interval, grouped by optimizer step. Both are driver-recorded with explicit start/finish timestamps and joined on overlap. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('async_phase_window','rollout_call') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), p AS (SELECT execution_uid,CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT) AS step,CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS started,CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS finished FROM r WHERE name='async_phase_window' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='training' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'), c AS (SELECT execution_uid,json_get(body_json,'call_id') AS call_id,CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS started,CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS finished,CAST(json_get(body_json,'response_tokens') AS BIGINT) AS tokens FROM r WHERE name='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'), coverage AS (SELECT execution_uid,COUNT(*) AS calls FROM c GROUP BY 1) SELECT p.execution_uid,p.step,CASE WHEN MIN(p.started)<CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) THEN 'partial interval' WHEN MAX(coverage.calls) IS NULL THEN 'no rollout records' ELSE 'observed' END AS coverage,CASE WHEN MIN(p.started)>=CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND MAX(coverage.calls)>0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.call_id) END AS completed_calls,CASE WHEN MIN(p.started)>=CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND MAX(coverage.calls)>0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(c.tokens),0) END AS returned_tokens FROM p LEFT JOIN coverage ON p.execution_uid=coverage.execution_uid LEFT JOIN c ON p.execution_uid=c.execution_uid AND c.started<p.finished AND c.finished>=p.started AND c.finished<p.finished GROUP BY p.execution_uid,p.step ORDER BY p.step

panels.title: Group dispositions / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_groups: the count of groups reaching each terminal disposition (consumed, rejected, stale_enqueue, shutdown-pending). Recorded once per group when record_group_disposition closes it out. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'rollout_groups' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'disposition') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,SUM(value) AS value FROM r GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens by group disposition / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_group_tokens: response tokens attached to each terminal group disposition. Recorded alongside rollout_groups by record_group_disposition. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'rollout_group_tokens' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'disposition') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,SUM(value) AS value FROM r GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training reward and informative groups
panels.description: training_metric_value for reward/avg_raw_reward, reward/avg_pass_at_4 and reward/informative_group_fraction, one point per optimizer step. Logged by the trainer from the reward-shaping and group-admission pass over each mini-batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'training_metric_value' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' ' || json_get(attributes_json,'payload_kind') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('reward/avg_raw_reward','reward/avg_pass_at_4','reward/informative_group_fraction') ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Evaluation scores
panels.description: training_metric_value for every eval/% metric: held-out scores mirrored from the evaluation tracker. Written only at evaluation steps, one point per metric and execution. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; blank between evaluation steps means no evaluation ran, not zero accuracy.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'training_metric_value' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' ' || json_get(attributes_json,'payload_kind') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%' ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Consumed length stops and coverage
panels.description: training_metric_value for consumed/length_stop_fraction and consumed/stop_reason_coverage: the share of admitted response sequences that hit a length stop, gated on full stop-reason coverage. Logged by the trainer after the learner update consumes the batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; the fraction is null wherever coverage is incomplete.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'training_metric_value' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), m AS (SELECT execution_uid,json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS step,timestamp_ms,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') AS metric,value FROM r WHERE json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('consumed/length_stop_fraction','consumed/stop_reason_coverage') AND json_get(attributes_json,'payload_kind')='train' AND json_get(attributes_json,'role')='trainer'), s AS (SELECT execution_uid,step,MAX(timestamp_ms) AS timestamp_ms,MAX(CASE WHEN metric='consumed/length_stop_fraction' THEN value END) AS length_fraction,MAX(CASE WHEN metric='consumed/stop_reason_coverage' THEN value END) AS coverage FROM m GROUP BY execution_uid,step) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,metric || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN metric='consumed/length_stop_fraction' THEN CASE WHEN coverage=1 THEN length_fraction END ELSE coverage END AS value FROM s CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('consumed/length_stop_fraction'),('consumed/stop_reason_coverage')) AS metrics(metric) ORDER BY t,series

panels.title: Optimizer diagnostics
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/policy_entropy, policy/raw_grad_norm, policy/policy_kl, policy/final_loss and policy/policy_loss, one point per optimizer step. panels.title: Inference sampled throughput by learner phase
panels.description: vLLM generation_tokens_total / prompt_tokens_total counter deltas, rated per covered second and joined to async_phase_window driver phases. The vLLM engines export the counters independently; the trainer emits the phase windows to join against. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('async_phase_window','generation_tokens_total','prompt_tokens_total') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), windows AS (
SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,seq,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') AS phase,
CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS started_ms,
CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS finished_ms
FROM r WHERE name='async_phase_window' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'
AND CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT)>CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT)
AND ABS((CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS DOUBLE)-CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS DOUBLE))/1000-CAST(json_get(body_json,'duration_seconds') AS DOUBLE))<0.005
), counters AS (
SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,json_get(attributes_json,'engine') AS engine,
COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'model_name'),'') AS model,timestamp_ms,seq,value
FROM r WHERE name IN ('generation_tokens_total','prompt_tokens_total')
AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric_source')='vllm'
AND json_get(attributes_json,'source_temporality')='cumulative_snapshot'
AND json_get(attributes_json,'engine') IS NOT NULL
), lagged AS (
SELECT *,LAG(timestamp_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq) AS previous_ms,
LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq) AS previous_value FROM counters
), engines AS (SELECT DISTINCT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model FROM counters), per_window AS (
SELECT w.execution_uid,w.resource_attributes_json,w.seq,w.phase,e.name,e.engine,e.model,
(w.finished_ms-w.started_ms)/1000.0 AS window_seconds,
SUM(l.value-l.previous_value) AS tokens,SUM((l.timestamp_ms-l.previous_ms)/1000.0) AS covered_seconds,COUNT(l.timestamp_ms) AS intervals
FROM windows w JOIN engines e ON w.execution_uid=e.execution_uid AND w.resource_attributes_json=e.resource_attributes_json
LEFT JOIN lagged l ON e.execution_uid=l.execution_uid AND e.resource_attributes_json=l.resource_attributes_json AND e.name=l.name AND e.engine=l.engine AND e.model=l.model
AND l.previous_ms>=w.started_ms AND l.timestamp_ms<=w.finished_ms AND l.timestamp_ms>l.previous_ms AND l.value>=l.previous_value
GROUP BY w.execution_uid,w.resource_attributes_json,w.seq,w.phase,e.name,e.engine,e.model,w.started_ms,w.finished_ms
)
SELECT execution_uid AS execution,json_get(resource_attributes_json,'host') AS collector,phase,engine,model,name AS counter,
SUM(tokens)/NULLIF(SUM(covered_seconds),0) AS tokens_per_sampled_second,
COALESCE(SUM(covered_seconds),0)/NULLIF(SUM(window_seconds),0) AS coverage_fraction,
SUM(intervals) AS intervals,SUM(window_seconds) AS phase_seconds
FROM per_window GROUP BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,phase,engine,model,name ORDER BY execution,phase,engine,counter

 SELECT run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step,MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_min' THEN maximum END) AS staleness_min, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_max' THEN maximum END) AS staleness_max, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS loss_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_response_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS response_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='consumed/sequences' THEN maximum END) AS sequences, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/mismatch/pooled/log_ratio_mean_squared' THEN maximum END) AS mslr, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/mismatch/pooled/ess_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS ess, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='reward/avg_raw_reward' THEN maximum END) AS reward, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/mismatch/pooled/finite_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS finite_fraction, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/mismatch/pooled/missing_behavior' THEN maximum END) AS missing_behavior, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/policy_loss' THEN maximum END) AS policy_loss,
 SUM(CASE WHEN minimum<>maximum OR samples<>values_present THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' AND (samples<>values_present OR minimum<>maximum OR minimum<0 OR maximum>=1e308 OR maximum<>FLOOR(maximum)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_conflicts
 FROM metrics GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN conflicts=0 AND staleness_min=staleness_max AND staleness_min>=0 AND staleness_min=FLOOR(staleness_min)
 AND loss_tokens>0 AND loss_tokens<1e308 AND loss_tokens=FLOOR(loss_tokens)
 AND response_tokens>=0 AND response_tokens<1e308 AND response_tokens=FLOOR(response_tokens) AND sequences>0 AND sequences<1e308 AND sequences=FLOOR(sequences)
 AND mslr>=0 AND mslr<1e308 AND ess>0 AND ess<=1 AND finite_fraction=1 AND missing_behavior=0
 AND reward BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 AND policy_loss BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible
 FROM batches
), grouped AS (
 SELECT 'Uniform-staleness batches' AS status,execution_uid AS execution,CAST(staleness_min AS BIGINT) AS staleness,
 COUNT(*) AS updates,SUM(response_tokens)/SUM(sequences) AS mean_response_tokens,
 SUM(mslr*loss_tokens)/SUM(loss_tokens) AS token_weighted_mslr,MIN(ess) AS minimum_ess_fraction,
 AVG(reward) AS mean_update_raw_reward
 FROM classified WHERE eligible=1 GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,staleness_min
)
SELECT COALESCE(grouped.status,'No qualifying uniform-staleness batches') AS status,grouped.execution,grouped.staleness,grouped.updates,
 grouped.mean_response_tokens,grouped.token_weighted_mslr,grouped.minimum_ess_fraction,grouped.mean_update_raw_reward
FROM (VALUES (1)) AS selection(present) LEFT JOIN grouped ON TRUE
ORDER BY execution,staleness

 SUM(CASE WHEN minimum<>maximum OR samples<>values_present THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts,

 FROM metrics GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step

 AND loss_tokens>0 AND loss_tokens<1e308 AND loss_tokens=FLOOR(loss_tokens)
